groups.name: What is solved
groups.blurb: The physics: a model, which brings its own species, variables and propagators.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Physics model that provides species, propagators and variables.

groups.name: Where it lives
groups.blurb: The mapped geometry, the background it is initialized from, and the element grid covering it.

parameters.name: grid
parameters.description: Spatial grid used for FEEC variables.

fields.name: num_elements
fields.description: Number of elements in each direction.

fields.name: mpi_dims_mask
fields.description: True if the dimension is to be used in the domain decomposition (=default for each dimension). If mpi_dims_mask[i]=False, the i-th dimension will not be decomposed.

groups.name: How it is discretized
groups.blurb: Spline degrees and boundary conditions for the de Rham complex the fields live in.

fields.name: degree
fields.description: Spline degree in each logical direction ``(eta_1, eta_2, eta_3)``.

fields.name: bcs
fields.description: Boundary condition selector for each direction. Use ``None`` in a direction for periodic boundaries, or a tuple ``(left, right)`` with entries in ``{"free", "dirichlet"}`` for non-periodic boundaries.

fields.name: nquads
fields.description: Number of Gauss-Legendre quadrature points per direction for cell integrals. If ``None``, backend defaults are used.

fields.name: nquads_proj
fields.description: Number of Gauss-Legendre quadrature points per direction for geometric projector/histopolation integrals. If ``None``, backend defaults are used.

fields.name: polar_splines
fields.description: Smoothness at a possible polar singularity at ``eta_1 = 0``. ``False`` gives standard tensor-product splines, ``True`` gives C1 polar splines.

fields.name: local_projectors
fields.description: Whether to build local commuting projectors based on quasi-inter-/histopolation.

groups.name: How it steps
groups.blurb: Step size, end time, and how the model's propagators are composed over a step.

fields.name: dt
fields.description: Time step.

fields.name: Tend
fields.description: End time.

fields.name: split_algo
fields.description: Splitting algorithm (the order of the propagators is defined in the model).

groups.name: How it runs
groups.blurb: Output folders, restarts, MPI, and what the profiler records — everything around the physics.

fields.name: out_folders
fields.description: Absolute path to directory for ``sim_folder``.

fields.name: sim_folder
fields.description: Folder in ``out_folders/`` for the current simulation (default= ``sim_1/`` ). Will create the folder if it does not exist OR cleans the folder for new runs.

fields.name: sim_label
fields.description: Label for the simulation (default=None)

fields.name: restart
fields.description: Whether to restart a run (default=False).

fields.name: max_runtime
fields.description: Maximum run time of simulation in minutes. Will finish the time integration once this limit is reached (default=300).

fields.name: save_step
fields.description: When to save data output: every time step (save_step=1), every second time step (save_step=2), etc (default=1).

fields.name: save_restart
fields.description: Whether to write the restart checkpoint (full marker arrays and FEEC restart coefficients, written once at setup and once at the end of the run). Restart data can dominate the run time for large particle counts; set to ``False`` to skip it when restart capability isn't needed, e.g. for pure timing/benchmark runs (default=True).

fields.name: sort_step
fields.description: Sort markers in memory every N time steps (default=0, which means markers are sorted only at the start of simulation)

fields.name: num_clones
fields.description: Number of domain clones (default=1)

parameters.name: profiling_opts
parameters.description: Options passed to scope-profiler when profiling is active.

parameters.name: comm
parameters.description: MPI communicator for parallel execution. If None, uses MPI.COMM_WORLD.

parameters.name: logging_level
parameters.description: Logging level (e.g., logging.INFO, logging.DEBUG). If None, uses default.

groups.name: How it is labelled
groups.blurb: Carried into the run's metadata, so a saved run says what it was.

parameters.name: params_path
parameters.description: Path to a Python parameter file to save alongside outputs.
